body.title: Payment Operations Analyst
body.aiReason: Matches data analytics, SQL, dashboard/ETL skills; client reputable; no scam red flags.
body.description:
About the Role
We are seeking a Payment Operations Analyst with strong technical and analytical capabilities to drive operational excellence across our Payments team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with payment flows and system integrations, coupled with the ability to troubleshoot issues, extract insights from data, and build compelling reports that inform business decisions, all while thriving in a fast-moving environment.
Key Responsibilities
• Support daily operations of payment products, ensuring smooth functionality and optimal performance.
• Investigate and resolve payment-related issues across gateways, acquirers, and payment methods.
• Analyze payment data to identify trends, anomalies, and improvement opportunities (e.g., declines, approval rates).
• Build and maintain medium to advanced reporting dashboards and perform ad-hoc analysis to track payment performance metrics and KPIs.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, IT, Finance, Disputes and Fraud) to resolve escalations, identify root causes, and improve processes.
• Work with external partners (PSPs, acquirers and alternative payment providers) to ensure seamless operations and efficient issue resolution.
• Support and monitor payment integrations, ensuring correct implementation and ongoing stability.
• Assist in managing payment flows, including authorization, capture, refunds, VAMP and 3DS authentication.
• Contribute to process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency.
Required Skills & Experience
• At least 2+ years of hands-on experience in payment flows and payment operations (mandatory)
• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
• Proficiency in SQL — ability to write complex queries for data extraction, transformation, and validation across large datasets.
• Strong Excel skills — including pivot tables, VLOOKUP and advanced formula work.
• Hands-on experience with BI tools such as BigQuery, Preset — querying, aggregating, and analyzing payment data at scale.
• Experience building dashboards and reports — translating raw data into actionable business insights and visualizations.
• Familiarity with payment gateways, APIs, and integration flows.
• Medium to advanced reporting experience — ability to design metrics, build automated reports, and create self-service analytics for stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Nice-to-Have
• Experience with payment compliance and fraud monitoring frameworks.
• Familiarity with Stripe, Adyen, or similar payment processor ecosystems.
• Background in dispute management, fraud or chargeback operations.
• Experience with payment webhooks and real-time event processing.
